fieldValues.title: repo create leaves the .srs marker unreachable by git
fieldValues.summary: srs repo create produces a .srs marker directory with no regular file inside it, and git does not track empty directories. A repository created by the tool therefore stops being a repository on its first commit.
evidence: srs-rust#959 records that srs repo create writes .srs/ containing no regular file.
Git does not track empty directories, and archive pack/unpack drops them, so the marker round-trips as absent.
check-programme-conformance.mjs asserts .srs/ holds at least one regular file precisely because repo validate cannot catch this — the defect only appears after a commit or a pack cycle.
